level2.title: TUTORIAL 2: TRAITS
level2.description: LEARN ABOUT TRAITS AND THEIR EFFECT ON UNITS AND SPELLS.
level2.1: Welcome back, OpenSky! Ready for another match?'
level2.4: Keep training with the bot to get more tips!
level2.6: Don't worry, we'll get them next time!
level2.8: It gives your hero +1 power this turn.
level2.9: Many OpenSky cards have powerful abilites,
level2.10: So be sure to check them carefully!
level2.12: The yellow glow shows that this unit has Banner.
level2.13: As long as a Unit with Banner is in play,
level2.15: Notice how this Unit is shaped like a shield?
level2.16: That's because they have the Guard Trait.
level2.17: They prevent the hero from being attacked.
level2.19: Remember! You gotta deal with Guard Units first,
level2.20: Before you can attack their hero!
level2.22: This Unit is hidden by its Stealth Trait.
level2.23: It's being protected by its hero.
level2.24: To reveal it, you need to damage the enemy hero.
level2.25: When a hero is damaged, their Units lose Stealth.
level2.26: But only temporarily. It will regain Stealth next turn.
level2.29: When a Spell with Wither damages a Unit,
level2.30: It will reduce both their Health and Power!
level2.31: This dark aura shows that the Unit has Wither.
level2.32: When a Unit with Wither damages a Unit,
level2.33: it will reduce their health, and also their Power.
level2.34: Take note! Wither can't reduce a hero's Power!
level2.35: Let's use our Wither Unit to weaken the enemy!
level2.36: Nice! Wither took its Power away!
level2.37: Now our other Units can attack it safely!

level3.title: TUTORIAL 3: ABILITIES
level3.description: LEARN ABOUT UNIQUE ABILITIES, LIKE SUMMON, DEATH, AND INSPIRE.
level3.1: Welcome back, OpenSky! Ready for another match?
level3.4: You should play the next tutorial for more advanced tips!
level3.5: Aw rats! Looks like we lost.
level3.6: Don't worry, we'll get them next time!
level3.7: Oh! Be sure to check cards in your hand before you attack!
level3.8: Some spells can help clear the way for your units!
level3.9: That Sword symbol is a Glory Effect!
level3.10: It will activate when this Unit attacks a hero,
level3.12: Awesome! Your Unit's Glory Effect activated!
level3.13: Good job attacking the enemy hero!
level3.14: Oh look! That Unit's Death effect activated!
level3.15: Whoa! This Unit had a Play Effect.
level3.16: It activated when the Unit was played from hand!
level3.17: When going first, you get an extra mana crystal!
level3.18: You can use it to play extra cards!
level3.19: That Skull on this Unit is a Death Effect.
level3.20: That means something will happen when it dies!
level3.21: Oh wait! There's still more we can do this turn!
level3.22: Try to spend all your mana before passing!
level3.23: This Unit had a Summon Effect!
level3.24: It activated when the Unit entered play!
level3.25: Our opponent left a Spell on this Unit!
level3.26: If we get rid of this Unit,
level3.27: Any attached Spells it has will be lost!
level3.28: Be careful when leaving Spells attached!
level3.29: Oh look! That Unit's Death effect activated!
level3.30: This Unit has a Sunset Effect.
level3.31: It will activate at the end of its player's turn.
level3.32: The Star on this Unit is an Inspire Effect!
level3.33: It will activate when its player plays a card that meets the requirements.
level3.34: In this case, it wants a card of the "Light" Element!
level3.35: Oh, this card has a Play effect! Try using it!
